name: Hotel Gasthof Neuner
beschreibung: Hotel Gasthof Neuner is a well-established traditional inn situated in Imst in Tyrol's Upper Inn Valley. Nestled beneath the impressive backdrop of the Lechtal Alps, the property features guest areas and rooms decorated in authentic Tyrolean style. Guests enjoy swift access to the Hoch-Imst ski area and extensive alpine hiking paths. Amenities include an inviting restaurant serving fresh local cuisine and convenient private parking.
kurzbeschreibung: Hotel Gasthof Neuner in Imst offers traditional Tyrolean character in the Upper Inn Valley, fine regional dining, guest parking, and easy access to Hoch-Imst.
